description.value: Deer Garden Signatures is a well-regarded Chinese restaurant chain with three Metro Vancouver locations; the Fraser Street branch (DG3) is its South Vancouver outpost. The restaurant is known for its signature fish soup noodles (魚湯米線) made without MSG, a draw highlighted prominently across its website. Both dine-in and online ordering are available at this location.
